name: Kuwait
shortSummary: Kuwait is a significant energy supplier to India and home to roughly a million Indian expatriates; ties were elevated with a Strategic Partnership announced during PM Modi's December 2024 visit — the first Indian prime ministerial visit to Kuwait in decades.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Kuwait is a major crude and LPG supplier, and its large Indian workforce drives substantial remittances.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
